description: FAST vanilla-transformer comparison baseline. Byte-for-byte clone of exp002_untied_vanilla_baseline_nebius (pure MinimalGPT + RoPE, untied head, standard dense GELU FFN 384->1536->384 -- NO LUT / hyperplane modules anywhere; train.py copied verbatim, it is fully config-driven) with EXACTLY ONE change: n_steps 16000 -> 4096. Everything else is byte-identical to exp002: d_model 384, 6 layers, 6 heads, seq 512, device_batch_size 48, total_batch_size 24576 (grad_accum 1), lr 3e-4, wd 0.1, warmup 0.1, eval_every 200, eval_steps 10, seed 1, bf16, vocab 32768, same base_data_climbmix subset + tokenizer. Purpose: a quick (~8 min on H100) dense-FFN anchor to A/B future LUT/hyperplane experiments against without the ~0.54h full-baseline wait. NOT the reproducibility anchor -- exp002 (1.20144 bpb, 16k steps) remains the on-box reference number; this short run trains 4096/16000 = 25.6% of the steps so it will land HIGHER, and is only a fast relative yardstick.
